mu_name_from: WebZen GameServer 1.00.93 lang/main/item.txt:351, group 12 index 16 ("Orb of Fire Slash", MagicInf.cpp:177 teaches AT_SKILL_DEFENSEDOWN, 55); OpenMU VersionSeasonSix/Items/Orbs.cs:46. MU's name; its number here is ours, 16 being the Jewel of Life's neighbour in this table (docs/plans/mg-skills/fire-slash.md section 1).
why_this_one:
The only way the Magic Gladiator learns Fire Slash, his own sweep (docs/plans/mg-skills/fire-slash.md). Group 12 number 27 is ours: MU's 16 is taken here, and 0-22 and 25 are used on main while branch darklord's plan holds 23, 24 and 26.

Its drop level is MU's 60 (item.txt:351), 51,000 zen, and it drops only: Hanzo sells the early orbs (sim/market.cpp), not this one.
mesh_note: No geometry of its own. Gem01.bmd through Gem05.bmd are byte-identical in MuMain's Data/Item -- one md5 across all five -- so every orb in MU is one model told apart by its row, and this names the one the pipeline has built.

stats.note: An orb has no damage roll and no hand: it is a Prize and nothing else, and the shape of the row is the elf orbs' own (Version075/Items/Orbs.cs:63-67) -- one cell, durability one, dropped by monsters.
stats.durability_note: One. One reading, as a scroll is.
stats.classes_from: MG1 alone in WebZen's row (item.txt:351) and OpenMU's CreateOrb(..., MG); the Magic Gladiator's, as its skill is (sim::skillFor).
stats.requires_note: What the character must BE to read it. Level 120 is ours (the user, 2026-10-24: "add some level requirments"): our orbs ask about twice their drop level -- Cyclone 72 at 36, Slash 104 at 52, Death Stab 120 at 60 -- and this one drops at 60, so Death Stab's tier. The strength is MU's raw 320 (item.txt:351, OpenMU Orbs.cs:46), which sim::asks runs through the requirements' formula as WebZen's zzzitem.cpp:457 does: 20 + 320 x 60 x 3 / 100 = 596, asked of his strength with its bonuses at the read (Realm::useItem; protocol.cpp:17795). No energy (MagicDamage.cpp:705). The same level is on the skill block below and on the skill's row (sim/skills.cpp needLevel) -- the three must agree.

skill.note: What the orb teaches. Read once and gone -- the durability of one is what 'used once' means on this row.
skill.name: Fire Slash
skill.tells: A ribbon of fire swept round the half in front of him within two and a half tiles. What it burns may lose a tenth of its defence for ten seconds.
skill.tells_from: The skill's own line in sim/skills.cpp, kept letter for letter so the orb's tooltip and the skill's card cannot say different things about the same blow. MU never prints a line like this at all; it is ours, as it is on the elf's orbs.
skill.energy_from: None: WebZen overrides skill 55 to no energy (MagicDamage.cpp:705), and OpenMU asks none.
skill.level_from: Ours: twice the orb's drop level, as Death Stab's 120 at 60 (the user, 2026-10-24: "add some level requirments"). MU asks no level (MagicDamage.cpp:683-689).
